chunks: Muḥammad ibn Murāzim narrated from his father, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If the crescent is encircled, then it is for two nights; and if you see the shadow of your head in it, then it is for three nights."

key_terms.الْهِلالُ: the new crescent moon marking the beginning of the lunar month
key_terms.تَطَوَّقَ: became encircled or surrounded by a ring
key_terms.لِثَلَاثِ لَيَالٍ: indicating that it is three nights old
key_terms.لِلَّيْلَتَيْنِ: indicating that it is two nights old

ai.seo_question: What signs indicate whether the crescent moon is two or three nights old?
ai.summary: This hadith gives observational signs for estimating how many nights have passed since the appearance of the crescent moon. It relates to determining the lunar month in the context of fasting and moon-sighting.
